node.title: Re: Passing Parameters to subroutine
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
When passing a parameter via the command line, getopts seems to pass the parmeter on the cli followed by a 1 to the identified subroutine. I would be expecting ...

[doc://Getopt::Long#User-defined-subroutines-to-handle-options|This is documented behavior], since it's a boolean option the 1 represents that the option was passed. Also, [id://11140962|as discussed last time], the only thing the subroutines called by [doc://Getopt::Long] should be doing is storing the fact that the options were passed to the program. If you use the module as intended, I think you'll have an easier time.
